deviceBrands.klipperHint: Mainsail and Fluidd show it in their settings.
deviceBrands.klipperLocked: This printer is locked: type its API key
deviceBrands.prusaHint: The printer shows it under Settings, Network, PrusaLink (the user name there is maker).
deviceBrands.prusaLocked: Type the PrusaLink password from the printer's screen
deviceBrands.octoprintHint: In OctoPrint: Settings, Application Keys, then make a key for Cloud Slicer (or copy your user's API key under Settings, API).
deviceBrands.octoprintLocked: This OctoPrint is locked: type an API key from its settings
deviceBrands.bambuHint: The printer shows it on its screen, in its network settings next to LAN Only mode. To send prints and control it from here, also turn on LAN Only mode and Developer Mode there (Bambu's cloud and the Bambu Handy app stop working while they're on).
deviceBrands.bambuLocked: Type the access code from the printer's screen
deviceBrands.bambuExamples: X1, P1, P2S, A1, H2; camera on P1 and A1; needs Developer Mode
